dslRule:
<!id: remove.redundant.long.field.init>
<!description: Remove redundant initialization of long fields to 0 or 0L.>
<!severity: HINT>

$modifiers$ long $name = $init; :: isField($name) && matchesAny($init, "0", "0L")
=>
$modifiers$ long $name;
;;
summary: Removes redundant initialization of long fields to their default value (0 or 0L).
